issue.title: dash_projects.md projects-by-start-date query on the ^prj inline date

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a Tasks query to the vault's dash_projects.md listing open #prj tasks (^prj lines) with a scheduled date after today, sorted by scheduled. This recovers the projects-by-start-date view the frontmatter scheduled key used to give. Mind the tags-include #prj substring hazard (#prj_is_blocked); match ^prj lines or use a regex.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Out of scope for epic bob-cli-6u (plan:202610/prj_line_project_blocking.md lists it under Deliberately not doing / publish follow-ups); proposed by bob-cli-6u.17. Vault content edit, not code.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-6u.17 (note #5): moving project dates onto the ^prj line removed the frontmatter-based by-date view.
